item_short_desc: Rothco’s Rubber Training Knife is made to replicate a real knife in almost every way, providing you with a safe, more realistic way to train (It is recommended to wear appropriate face and eye protection as this item can still cause harm).
description: Rothco’s Rubber Training Knife is made to replicate a real knife in almost every way, providing you with a safe, more realistic way to train. Constructed with thermoplastic rubber, the training knife’s design is resilient enough to hold its shape, while flexible enough to bend. The handle measures 5 ½” X 1”, and features grip texture and a finger groove for better control while training. With a 6” blade and an overall length of 11 ½”, the rubber training knife is perfect for a variety of training exercises, including knife training, self-defense drills, and much more.
